named_subject: a penguin: round head with a pointed beak, oval body with a large belly patch, and a flipper on each side
action: The penguin stands in place, sways slightly left and right, and bobs and tilts its head so the beak points level and then dips downward near the end.
identity_gap: The animated figure keeps the doodle's head circle, wedge beak, open oval belly, two flippers and short stroke marks, so it reads as the same drawing.
notes: The head bob and the beak dipping around frames 13 to 15 match the film, but the film character's body leans diagonally up to the right while the drawing stays upright and only shifts a little. The change that would help most is tilting the body to match the film's lean and enlarging the head and beak movement so the talking motion is visible.
